If you checked box 2 or 5, enter 2 in the box. If you checked the box on line 6, see instructions." (the filing-status boxes: 1 Single, 2 Married/RDP filing jointly, 3 Married/RDP filing separately, 4 Head of household, 5 Qualifying surviving spouse/RDP). Booklet p. 12, Line 6: "Check the box on line 6 if someone else can claim you or your spouse/RDP as a dependent on their tax return, even if they chose not to." Line 7, when line 6 is checked: "Single or married/RDP filing separately, enter -0-." "Head of household, enter -0-." "Married/RDP filing jointly and both you and your spouse/RDP can be claimed as dependents, enter -0-." "Married/RDP filing jointly and only one spouse/RDP can be claimed as a dependent, enter 1." Line 8 (blind): Form 540 line 8 "Blind: If you (or your spouse/RDP) are visually impaired, enter 1; if both are visually impaired, enter 2." Booklet p. 12, Line 8: "Visually impaired means not capable of seeing better than 20/200 while wearing glasses or contact lenses, or if your field of vision is not more than 20 degrees." "The first year you claim this exemption credit, attach a doctor's statement to the back of Form 540 indicating you or your spouse/RDP are visually impaired." "Do not claim this credit if someone else can claim you as a dependent on their tax return." Only a joint return enters 2: the second count is the spouse/RDP's ("if both"). Pack notes: Base guidance: Supply California adjusted gross income — 2023 Form 540, line 17 ('California adjusted gross income. Combine line 15 and line 16'), i.e. federal AGI (line 13) plus California additions minus California subtractions per Schedule CA (540). Do NOT supply unmodified federal AGI: California does not conform to federal income tax treaties (treaty-exempt income is added back on Schedule CA) and has other adjustments. The op subtracts the shipped per-status standard deduction to reproduce line 19 (taxable income, floored at 0) and applies the rate schedule to reproduce line 31 — the tax BEFORE exemption credits (line 32; see tax.exemption_credits) and special credits. Adjudication note (two-pass): base is federal_agi — Form 540 line 13 is federal AGI and line 17 California AGI = federal AGI +/- Schedule CA (540) adjustments; supply line 17 as taxable_base (the op subtracts the line 18 standard deduction). California exemptions are $144/$446 CREDITS (lines 7-10), so vectors pass zero exemptions_count/dependents_count by design (the credits have their own input, exemption_credit_counts, and block, tax.exemption_credits). EXEMPTIONS ARE TAX CREDITS, NOT DEDUCTIONS: California's personal exemption ($144 per exemption, Form 540 lines 7-9: personal, blind, senior) and dependent exemption ($446 per dependent, line 10) are exemption CREDITS totaled on line 11 and subtracted from TAX on Form 540 line 32 — they never reduce taxable income, so exemptions_count and dependents_count are refused. tax is line 31 (tax before exemption credits); pass exemption_credit_counts (personal, blind, senior, dependent) with federal_agi and the result's exemption_credits carries lines 7-11, 32 and 33 (tax.exemption_credits, Phase K JK28). Special credits (lines 40-47) stay on the form. Exemption-credit AGI limitation (applied with the credits, from tax.exemption_credits.agi_limitation): if federal AGI (Form 540 line 13) exceeds $237,035 (single/MFS), $474,075 (MFJ/qualifying surviving spouse), or $355,558 (head of household), the line 32 exemption credits are reduced via the AGI Limitation Worksheet (booklet p. 14). The worksheet takes $6 off each credit counted for each $2,500 ($1,250 married/RDP filing separately) of the excess, a fraction of a step counting as a whole one. Table mandate below $100,000 — 'Use only if your taxable income on Form 540, line 19 is more than $100,000. If $100,000 or less, use the Tax Table' (booklet pp. 13, 75): bracket math may differ by a few dollars within table bands; the filed form must use the Tax Table (booklet pp. 69-74). 1% Mental Health Services Tax is NOT modeled: if taxable income (line 19) exceeds $1,000,000, an additional 1% of the excess over $1,000,000 is due on Form 540 line 62 (booklet p. 16 worksheet). Alternative Minimum Tax (Form 540 line 61, Schedule P (540)) and other taxes/credit recapture (line 63, e.g. FTB 3805P early-distribution tax, IRC 409A NQDC 5% tax) are NOT modeled. FTB 3800 (tax for certain children with unearned income) and FTB 3803 (parents' election to report child's interest/dividends) change the line 31 computation and are NOT modeled. Standard-deduction gates NOT modeled: a person claimable as a dependent on another's return must use the California Standard Deduction Worksheet for Dependents (larger of earned income or the $1,250 minimum standard deduction, capped at the regular per-status amount) — not the chart amount; married/RDP filing separately, both spouses must either both itemize or both take the standard deduction; itemizers enter California itemized deductions from Schedule CA (540) Part II line 30 on line 18 instead of the standard deduction. Qualifying surviving spouse/RDP uses Schedule Y — identical to married/RDP filing jointly (engine's QSS-to-MFJ mapping matches the published schedule exactly).
